//dataDir: Where the ledger/decisions/blacklist live, relative to this file.
//knownCompaniesFile: Optional. A markdown file with '- **Company**' bullets; matches get flagged in the UI. null disables it.
//locationFilter: Free pre-filter that runs before any LLM call. Set enabled:false to skip it.
//commutableMarkers: Optional. If set, non-remote roles whose location names a specific city NOT in this list get filtered. Vague locations (no comma, e.g. 'United States') are never filtered -- too risky to guess.
